_descriptor_type: A type of descriptor. One of 'simulation', 'trace', and 'perf'.
_architecture: A name of the available architectures (PARAMS.<architecture>) found in scarab repository, which defines the machine parameters of the default configuration.
_experiment: The name of the experiment. scarab-infra will create a new folder named containing all files needed to execute the simulation in the <ROOT_DIR>/simulations/<experiment> directory. The folder will also contain all generated simulation statistics/outputs.
_workload_manager: manual: run each exp scenario with all the simpoints at a time, slurm: Slurm schedules simulations based on its policy
_root_dir: Root directory mounted into the docker container home, for instance, the user's home directory
_application_dir: The path to the benchmark application directory used for tracing or simulation.
_scarab_path: The path to the scarab repository that contains the scarab binary used to run the experiment.
_traces_dir: The local directory containing all simpointed traces
_top_simpoint: Run only top 3 simpoints stored in 'workloads_top_simp.json'. Must match td_load_record so the recorded per-simpoint CSVs cover the simpoints replayed here.
_simulations: Replay pass. Must mirror the suites/subsuites/simpoints of td_load_record so the derived <bench>_<simpt>_mem_bound_loads_*.csv filenames line up. Reads the recorded CSVs from --td_load_dir and force-hits loads whose recorded mean memory-bound ratio is above --td_load_replay_thresh.
_configurations: Requires td_load_record to have run first (same --td_load_dir). baseline is the untouched machine; replay_pc/replay_addr force L1-hit latency for loads whose recorded mean memory-bound ratio (keyed by instruction PC / data address respectively) exceeds --td_load_replay_thresh (p). The forced load's memory request is still issued, so memory traffic is unchanged; only the load completes at L1-hit latency. Sweep --td_load_replay_thresh to trace the counterfactual sensitivity (p=1.0 forces almost nothing, p=0.0 forces every recorded key).

replay_pc_50._params: Force-hit loads whose PC has recorded mean mem-bound ratio > p.

replay_pc_70._params: Force-hit loads whose PC has recorded mean mem-bound ratio > p.

replay_pc_90._params: Force-hit loads whose PC has recorded mean mem-bound ratio > p.

replay_addr_50._params: Force-hit loads whose data address has recorded mean mem-bound ratio > p.

replay_addr_70._params: Force-hit loads whose data address has recorded mean mem-bound ratio > p.

replay_addr_90._params: Force-hit loads whose data address has recorded mean mem-bound ratio > p.

_collect_stats: Stats collection settings for ./sci --collect-stats. configs: optional list of configuration names to collect (null or omitted = all configurations).
_visualize: Visualization settings for ./sci --visualize. Configure baseline and counters.
_mem: Memory scheduling and collection settings for Slurm jobs.
